meta.name: The Lovers
meta.description:
Janet is a foul-mouthed, hilarious, Belfast supermarket worker who doesn’t care about anything, including her life. Seamus is a handsome, self-centered, political broadcaster with what looks to be a perfect London life and a celebrity girlfriend. When they unexpectedly meet, they instantly clash – and yet also find themselves inextricably drawn to each other.

Rated 15 · Ended · First aired 7 Sept 2023 · United Kingdom · Language: English · 44 min
Studio: Drama Republic, Sky Studios · Network: Sky Atlantic

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A love story about two people who appear to be utterly wrong for each other, but may be entirely right, begins.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Seamus and Janet meet in Belfast and, after a glorious night of laughter and sexual tension, Janet makes a shocking suggestion.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Seamus' girlfriend whisks him away for the night and drags Janet along, too. An agonising night of lies and subterfuge ensues.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: At last, the day has come: the affair is on! But when they realise they've both 'caught feelings', things take a different turn.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Janet visits London to be with Seamus and have some touristy fun. But it's clear the lovers are keeping secrets from each other.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: It's over between Janet and Seamus, but Janet's boss urges her not to give up. Can they find a way back to each other?
